justification: The named pair is a valid different counterexample. For Shrikhande, the Cayley construction on Z₄² with generators ±(1,0), ±(0,1), ±(1,1) gives eigenvalues 2cos(πa/2)+2cos(πb/2)+2cos(π(a+b)/2), yielding spectrum {6¹,2⁶,(-2)⁹}. The rook graph K₄□K₄ has the same spectrum. Both are simple 16-vertex graphs, but their induced vertex neighborhoods are respectively C₆ and 2K₃, proving non-isomorphism. This pair differs from the reference five-vertex pair.
